emails.subject: SDE intern at Innerkore
emails.body:
Hi Innerkore team,

Your Qwen3 address parser turns messy Indian addresses into structured JSON off a 4.37M-record dataset you built yourself.

I built MedVault, which runs lab reports through a Gemini pipeline into a fixed JSON schema with a fallback parser for bad model output: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I'm based in Noida and could work out of your Delhi office.

I just finished an SDET internship at Basepair, where I fixed a production OAuth race condition, and can join immediately. Does the team take on an engineering intern?
